## Five sights to start with

| Sight | Price band | Nearest tube |
|---|---|---|
| British Museum | Free | Tottenham Court Road |
| Natural History Museum | Free | South Kensington |
| Tate Modern | Free | Southwark |
| National Gallery | Free | Charing Cross |
| Tower of London | Paid | Tower Hill |

> **Tip from a local:** many big museums are free. Book a free timed ticket to skip the queue.

Plan your route: tfl.gov.uk/plan-a-journey
